svg.title: System diagram: natural-language query path (DataVox-style, high level)
svg.desc: Client sends a natural-language question to a FastAPI gateway, which enqueues a task on RabbitMQ. Celery workers consume it, call an LLM tier (self-hosted vLLM or managed AWS Bedrock) to turn the question into SQL, execute it on the SQL engine, and a renderer turns rows into charts and insights that return through the gateway. Redis caches results; MongoDB holds state and history. Illustrative and generic, not the production topology.
